attempts.reason: ds4 high-thinking run exceeded practical runtime; stopped by operator after ds4 produced long THINKING responses.

bundles.lesson: ds4 maps medium/low/minimal/high reasoning_effort to normal HIGH thinking; with 16k max_tokens, individual Beer Game decisions can spend thousands of hidden reasoning tokens and run for tens of minutes to hours.

lessons: Bench runner progress logging is required for long GABM runs; without per-week/per-role logs, an active model call looks stuck.
ds4 reasoning_effort values are not calibrated like gpt-oss; medium is high-thinking in ds4.
A ds4-only correction would not be fair after prompt tuning; Run 2 should rerun every contender under the same prompt version.

ds4_prompt_tuning.description: Screened medium-thinking ds4 across max_tokens, thinking-budget instruction, and output strictness on the week-1 retailer case.

result.lesson: A 100-token budget instruction helped, but most 2048-token variants still spilled reasoning into final content and hit the cap.

ds4_prompt_tuning.description: Held max_tokens=2048, reasoning_effort=medium, and budget_instruction=100 while sweeping system prompt contract and user prompt shape.

result.lesson: The system prompt mattered more than stricter user output formatting; front-loaded output contracts often increased visible reasoning.

ds4_prompt_tuning.description: One direct ds4 call added explicit inventory-position semantics and a cautious policy shortcut.
ds4_prompt_tuning.lesson: The major token sink was ambiguity around on_order and shipment timing. Prompt v2 should clarify state semantics for every GABM model, while preserving the demand anchor rather than teaching a blanket zero-order rule.

ds4_prompt_tuning.description: Real bench smoke after tightening prompt v2 to a shared demand-anchored heuristic: order = max(0, round(recent_demand + 0.25 * (target_position - inventory_position))).
ds4_prompt_tuning.lesson: The final prompt-v2 formula preserved the demand anchor, avoided a blanket zero-order rule, and made ds4 medium-thinking smoke-testable with strict integer outputs.

attempts.scope: Full rerun of mechanistic, gemma4, gpt-oss, and ds4 so every GABM contender is evaluated under prompt_version gabm-v2.
attempts.prompt_change: Shared Beer Game state semantics: use on_order directly in inventory_position, do not reconstruct pipeline or compensate again for shipment_received, anchor orders on recent demand plus a cautious 0.25 adjustment toward target, and return exactly one non-negative integer.
